skill.name: shadcn-ui-designer
skill.description: Design and build modern UI components and pages using shadcn/ui. Creates clean, accessible interfaces with Tailwind CSS following shadcn principles. Use when building UI components, pages, forms, dashboards, or any interface work.
skill.body:

generated_query: I need to build a simple admin dashboard for my small SaaS app. The dashboard should have a sidebar navigation (with links like Dashboard, Users, Settings), a main content area that shows a grid of four stat cards (total users, active sessions, revenue, churn rate), and a table listing recent user sign-ups with columns for name, email, sign-up date, and status. Use a clean, modern design with lots of whitespace, subtle shadows, and accessible colors. The sidebar should be collapsible on smaller screens. Can you create the initial React component structure using Tailwind CSS and shadcn/ui component patterns? I want it to look professional and be responsive, but I'll handle the data fetching myself—just the UI layout and styling.
